# MyBatis 3 v3.6.0 Multi-Portal Documentation & Diagnostic Suite (Unofficial Drawlib & PNI501 Showcase)

> Unofficial community documentation, API & XML catalog, internal architecture walkthrough, and PNI501 software audit of MyBatis 3 v3.6.0 (`https://mybatis3.drawlib.com/`).
> Official MyBatis 3 documentation: https://mybatis.org/mybatis-3/

## Portals

- [MyBatis 3 User Guide (EN/JA)](https://mybatis3.drawlib.com/user_guide/): Practical developer guide covering `SqlSession` lifecycle, XML & annotation mappers, `<resultMap>` nested associations/collections, Dynamic SQL OGNL tags, L1/L2 caching, TypeHandlers, and plugins (`https://mybatis3.drawlib.com/user_guide/llms.txt`).
- [MyBatis 3 API & XML Reference Catalog (EN/JA)](https://mybatis3.drawlib.com/api/): Searchable symbol & XML DTD/XSD reference catalog (`https://mybatis3.drawlib.com/api/llms.txt`).
- [MyBatis 3 Internal Architecture Guide (EN/JA)](https://mybatis3.drawlib.com/architecture/): Source-level guide to MyBatis 3 v3.6.0 (`org.apache.ibatis`) internals (`https://mybatis3.drawlib.com/architecture/llms.txt`).
- [PNI501 Diagnostic Report (HTML & PDF)](https://mybatis3.drawlib.com/pni501/): Deterministic 15-stage static Java AST, package dependency DAG, hermetic Maven/JUnit 5 runtime, and security audit (`https://mybatis3.drawlib.com/pni501/pni501.pdf`, `https://mybatis3.drawlib.com/pni501/llms.txt`).
